title: Difficult To Use
text:
Difficult To Use. Where oh where to begin.. I'm not sure that even Mrs. Jetson would have used this.

Pros:
It has a very long cord that makes it easier to use without having to move from plug to plug.
Excellent suction and really picked up a lot of fur and dust.

Cons:
Poorly shipped. This is the only problem I ever have with Amazon. They don't ship large items very well. The outer box this came in was open and had been resealed and was crushed. The inner box with the vacuum was mangled and I had to slit open the whole box to get the vacuum out.

Very difficult to assemble. The instructions are fairly useless. One set on the hang tag suggests one assembly, the manual another. I have assembled 2 level bookcases without as much grief as this vacuum.

For something that is 99% plastic it is VERY heavy and difficult to maneuver. I banged into the legs of all my furniture trying to turn this. I thought that was one of the big selling points for Dyson was their ease of mobility. Not in my experience at all. The big ball does not allow it go under anything.

Emptying the dust bin is a nasty business.

To sum it up, there are a lot of less expensive vacuums with good suction out there. The execution of this machine is way too overwrought.
Does not appear to have any onboard storage for the attachments. Shows some in the diagrams, but I couldn't figure it out.
